7487.title: Desktop find-overlay shadow exceeds its viewport
7487.rootCauseOneLine: Two clean runs confirm an 8px margin around a foreground-colored shadow with an 8px offset and 24px blur; native visual clipping remains unverified.

prReviews.topFinding: Smaller dark shadow addresses source-level concerns, but arithmetic CSS assertions do not prove composited pixels are unclipped. No linked code was run.

7487.proposedFix: Validate a compact dark shadow or remove it while retaining the current view footprint; confirm real compositing in both appearances.
7487.caveats: The same agent repeated only the generated-document diagnostic in two clean checkouts. Missing OS browser libraries blocked pixels and screenshots; one existing Electron suite test also fails for missing libglib. Open linked PR 7486 prevents a duplicate fix.
